summary: Old Peg Leg Mountain lookout, begun 1913, moved to the Lassen County Fairgrounds in Susanville by 1985; condemned, then restored in 2023. Sources disagree on original vs replica.

facts.status_note: Restored in 2023 after years closed; no report found on whether it is open now.

access.note: Cal Fire said it would reopen to the public on July 22, 2023. No later report found on current hours.

events.note: Red River Lumber Company built the first Peg Leg lookout, packing materials in by horse
Cal Fire replaced the old mountain lookout with a new prefabricated structure; the old one was taken down
Old lookout reassembled at the Lassen County Fairgrounds as a working exhibit, per a July 1985 fair notice
Register says a replica was on display at the fairgrounds by 2008; sources disagree on whether the fairgrounds structure is the original
Closed after the tower was condemned for needed repairs, several years before 2023
Restoration began June 16, 2023: new roof, rebuilt, reinforced and painted tower and cab
Ribbon cutting and public reopening set for July 22, 2023; no later report found

resolved_conflicts.field: date the old lookout left the mountain

notes_for_editor: Sources conflict on whether the fairgrounds structure is the original 1913-era lookout or a replica. Lassen News says the old lookout went there; the register says the 1920s lookout went there and a replica was on display by 2008; the 1984 and 1985 county notices speak of a replica and then a reassembled exhibit. A CAL FIRE Facebook post (dates the move to 1985 and says replica) could not be read and is not used. The parent record dates the move to 1984. The Sierra Daily News original returned 403; the same text was read via NewsBreak. No report after July 2023 on current hours; the status note and access note say so.
